title: RtpQueueZ
description: RtpQueueZ is a lightweight Paper plugin for fast 1v1 RTP matchmaking.
body:
RtpQueueZ is a lightweight Paper plugin for fast 1v1 RTP matchmaking on Minecraft.

Players join a shared queue with /rtpqueue (aliases: /rtpq, /1v1).
When two players are found, they are teleported to a random safe location in configured worlds and placed facing each other for instant fights.

Features:

1v1 queue matchmaking
- Configurable RTP worlds
- Configurable RTP radius
- Safe teleport search
- Opponent glow for configurable time
- Configurable messages
- Configurable action bar text
- Localization via lang/ folder
- Automatic language by client locale (ru/en included)
- Perfect for practice servers, PvP arenas, and quick duel flow without menus.
